examples.name: Example authorizations
examples.description: This query will return a list of authorizations for a merchant.

examples.name: Example createAuthorization
examples.description: This mutation will create a new authorization for a merchant.

examples.name: Example createWalletAuthorization
examples.description: This call is used to create an authorization for a wallet payment via Apple Pay or Google Pay. It works in conjunction with our SDKs to allow you to create an authorization via our API.

examples.name: Example createCapture
examples.description: This mutation will capture an authorization for a merchant.

examples.name: Example createVoidForAuthorization
examples.description: This will void an authorization that has not been captured. If the authorization has been captured, this call will fail. The Authorization will have a status of CANCELED.
